resources.string: Allow
Camera access
FieldPass needs the camera to scan the code on the faculty screen (back camera) and to take your photo (front camera), only on the attempt screen. Photos are never picked from your gallery.
Camera access was turned off for FieldPass. Open app settings, choose Permissions, then Camera, and allow it.
Location access
FieldPass reads your location once, only while you check in, answer a checkpoint or check out, to compare it with the activity venue. It does not track you in the background.
Location access was turned off for FieldPass. Open app settings, choose Permissions, then Location, and allow it.
